name: Jalapeño-Green Goddess Greens with Turkey Meatballs, Avocado & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 small pkgs fresh basil
1 small pkg chives
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ avocados
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic. Divide between a blender and a large bowl. (Set bowl aside for later use.)
Pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and add leaves to the blender.
Roughly chop chives. Add to the blender.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the blender along with mayo, oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Blend on high, adding water a few tablespoons at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set dressing aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup mayonnaise
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add turkey, bread crumbs, and spices to the reserved bowl with the garlic; using your hands, mix well to combine. Using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the turkey mixture into meatballs and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg ground turkey
⅓ cup panko bread crumbs
1 ½ tsp paprika
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add meatballs and cook, turning occasionally, until golden brown and cooked through, 6-8 minutes. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in a clean large bowl.
Trim and slice radishes crosswise into thin rounds. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Halve and pit avocados; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and slice crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl, along with mixed greens and feta, then toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad and meatballs between plates or bowls. Drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
